evidence.title: Layer is ordered structural membership, not a child coordinate origin
evidence.contract: Deep collection recurses only through Layers; panel/repeater is one leaf. Member coordinates stay in containing page/state scope. Temporary reference-counted containers subtract/re-add the Layer origin without changing the authored coordinate frame.

evidence.title: Movement eligibility differs from moved-cache recursion
evidence.contract: Move event/member-info enumeration excludes own inline-hidden branches, but movement cache recursion still changes hidden and limbo descendants. It stops at non-Layer containers. MoveTo registers each visible member against the same requested target; its recorded delta can differ from the shared translated displacement. Public zero MoveBy emits only root Move.

evidence.title: Runtime bounds have filtering and sentinel quirks
evidence.contract: childrenBoundingRect excludes own hidden, limbo, fixed-horizontal panels and zero-by-zero Layers. It includes rotated/shadow bounds. Nonempty lists seed left/top=99999 and right/bottom=0: all-excluded yields negative dimensions, negative-only union extends to origin. _updateLayerRectCache actually stores these values. Empty list differs: zero bounds. Size event precedes location event.

evidence.title: Cache/data/style priority and instance keys
evidence.contract: Moved/resized caches beat data-left/top/width/height, which beat normal/effective style geometry. DOM string "0" counts as present. Cache keys are full element IDs; fixture row instances remain isolated. Native row binding and deletion lifecycle are not replayed here.

evidence.title: Layer Resize expands ordered members and reserves separate channels
evidence.contract: Root resize plus nested Layer resize and leaf resize/move reservations. Deep collection includes hidden/limbo. Root reads current bounds at queue start, rounds requested dimension differences then applies stop ratio. Leaf resize applies type gates; nonresizable leaf can move without resizing. Top-left, center and bottom-right numerical results are recorded. Nested Layer emits Resize but does not directly scale itself in this branch.

evidence.title: Layer Rotate has independent layerDegree and member orientation gates
evidence.contract: Root layerDegree caches full target before partial animation. Nested Layer gets Rotate event without changing its independent layerDegree. Leaf orbit pivot uses Layer bounding center plus anchor/offset in containing scope. Image/hotspot/panel/vector/line rotate orientation; other leaf types orbit only. New probes execute queue and producer but replace orbit rendering with an explicit argument/completion sink.

evidence.title: Combined Layer Resize and Rotate quirks
evidence.contract: Root Rotate is raised twice. Member pivot applies resizeInfo.anchor rather than rotateInfo.anchor. This branch does not apply clockwise sign; false still delivers +90 in the fixture. resizeOffset and per-member resizeDeltaMove are passed separately. This is not proof of full composed browser animation.

evidence.title: Propagate affects hover/down only, with a container barrier
evidence.contract: Missing/false propagate is false by runtime truthiness. Traversal skips a nonpropagating child container and its whole branch; ordinary leaves have no such flag gate. True container propagates hover/down through descendants including hidden/limbo. Upward lookup can cross false intermediate parent, returning direct=false. Container handlers paint children, not their own hover/down style. This flag is not a generic click broadcast flag.

evidence.title: Selected, Enabled and Error use different independent recursion
evidence.contract: Selected ignores propagate, includes hidden/limbo children, skips disabled subtree, emits child events before parent. Enabled/Error ignore propagate but use ignoreUnplaced=true, including hidden and skipping limbo. Grouped-selection and contained-owner redirection branches remain outside these fixtures.

evidence.title: Focus uses the first ordered child, not the first visible child
evidence.contract: Maps objs[0], follows nested Layer recursively, does not filter hidden/limbo, and does not fall back past an empty first Layer. Final input/img/div suffix selection remains ordered. Existing own focus interaction suppresses proxy need; ancestor focus interaction can request it.

evidence.title: Parent fitting and adaptive cache recomputation
evidence.contract: fitParentPanel first updates nearest Layer/RDO; only changed Layer bounds recurse upwards. Panel/row/body handling follows. updateAllLayerSizeCaches visits reverse collected Layer order, skipping own/ancestor limbo. Full fit/row/animation event integration is not executed by this stage, whose fit callback is a recording sink.

evidence.title: Show/hide and event bubbling remain separate from Propagate
evidence.contract: Layer show/hide uses a temporary container wrapper, like the panel path with isPanel=false, not a child hidden-flag rewrite. Limbo is an early gate. Generic handled-event/bubbling is separate from hover/down propagation. These complete browser event and visibility paths were read, not replayed here.

limits: No original Axure GUI was operated or pixel-compared by this stage; no proprietary DLL method executed.
All 78 current passing cases are isolated original-JavaScript NodeVM executions with declared in-memory DOM/query, style and scheduling facades. They are not 78 full-original-page/browser tests.

Original full math.js/move.js and named exact source slices are executed. CSS style resolution, fixed-position detection, expression compilation, real repeater binding, fit-parent completion, event listener reentrancy, annotation and flyout effects are not fully composed.

The action probe executes real producer/queue/public Resize and Move consumers. Its Rotate orbit is an explicit argument/completion sink. It establishes reservation, eligibility, pivot and cache/event inputs, not complete browser orbit pixels or timing.
Controlled animation completion is not real jQuery timing/easing. Nonzero-duration nested Layer queue interruption and reentrant fit/action behavior remain unverified.
All-filtered negative dimensions are proven in query and runtime caches. Browser treatment of negative CSS dimensions, visual wrapper clipping and product render guards require separate verification.

Managed editor bounds differ from runtime bounds: format-agent CIL reports flattened actual leaves with first-leaf union seed and no runtime visible/shadow filter. This report does not substitute the runtime sentinel rule for saved/editor geometry.

Selection groups, contained widget redirection, tree special recursion, fixed members, percent-width panels, full repeater lifecycle, focus delivery and generic click bubbling are not fully executed end to end.
No product sources or tests were changed. Proposed schema and implementation guidance below are recommendations, not claims of an already matching implementation.

data.widgets: ordered child identities, preserving nested Layers

modelRecommendation.geometry: Members remain in the containing non-Layer coordinate space. Keep declared/editor bounds distinct from cached runtime bounds. Do not add Layer x/y to members or apply a shared CSS rotate to the whole subtree.
modelRecommendation.rotation: Independent runtime layerDegree. Member geometry/orientation updates are actual motion operations, with type-specific eligibility.
modelRecommendation.state: Keep root state and ordered member recursion. Do not implement Propagate as a blanket event/disabled/selected broadcast switch.
